_about: Generic defaults for rkb, embedded in the binary. Paths are relative to code_root (the folder holding career/CurriculumVitae; found automatically, or set RKB_CODE_ROOT / --code-root). A skill folder's rkb/assets/config.json (RKB_SKILL_DIR, or the folder holding SKILL.md above the binary) replaces this file whole. repos, dependency_aliases, groups, bullet_rules.codenames and sibling_roots are per user and start empty.

layout._density: Font stays within 9.8-10.2pt of the 10pt template: a page that is short gets more evidence, not bigger type.

bullet_rules._codenames: Your own project codenames. A Summary bullet naming two or more of them is an error (introduce project names in their own sections). Empty turns off only that check.
bullet_rules._parity: parity_baselines: external baselines (names) whose "matched X" claim must state why matching is a result; empty turns the check off. parity_differentiators: regexps added to the generic wordings that state it (without Python, in-process, bit-identical, ...).
bullet_rules._mechanisms: Points your bullets keep making in different words, each {"id": name, "all": [case-insensitive regexps that must all match]}. Two bullets on one page making one point are refused. Empty: only an explicit per-bullet point is compared.
bullet_rules._personal_lists: Your own additions to the built-in generic lists, empty by default: lead_jargon (words kept out of a bold lead unless glossed), tech_terms (words counted as jargon), extra_banned and dup_phrases (case-insensitive regexps refused as filler or garbled wording), summary_banned (phrases refused in a Summary bullet).
bullet_rules._comparison: Recruiters weigh improvements and comparisons; hiring managers check the baseline. A comparison is before -> after, a multiple or percentage against a named alternative or the same system without the change ('vs', 'than', 'over', 'from X to Y', 'cut/raised by'). At least min_comparison_share of figured work bullets need one: a warning on drafts, an error under --final. A bullet with nothing honest to compare against carries comparison_ok with the reason.
bullet_rules._impact: An impact figure is a percentage, a multiple (×), a duration or a rate. Counts (12 services, 60 runs) are fine but do not count toward this share.
bullet_rules._testing: Resumes lead with what was built and its impact. A bullet whose bold lead, only figures, or dominant vocabulary is about testing counts as testing-centric: none in the Summary, at most max_testing_share overall (meta.max_testing_share raises it for QA/eval postings; a bullet can carry testing_ok).
